svg.text: Both models end in the same place: price at marginal cost c, output at the efficient level 1−c.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What differs is speed: Cournot's markup (1−c)/(n+1) decays slowly, Bertrand's undercutting arrives at once.
